title: Roles
intro: A custom role is a set of permissions for staff members. Give it to someone on the Team page; it replaces what staff can do for the permissions below, and nothing else changes.
readOnly: Only owners can create or change roles. You can see which roles exist.

empty.title: No custom roles yet
empty.description: Staff, managers, admins and owners work as before. Create a role to limit or extend what a staff member can do.

dialogDescription: Pick what people with this role may do. Anything left unticked is not allowed.
name: Role name
nameHint: Shown on the Team page, for example Greeter or Cashier.

call.label: Call guests
call.help: Call the next guest and call a guest again.

remove.label: Remove guests
remove.help: Remove or cancel a guest in the queue.

charge.label: Charge no-show fees
charge.help: Charge the fee on a held or stored card.

refund.label: Refund payments
refund.help: Refund all or part of a payment.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Nobody has this role. You can create it again later.
delete.inUse: People still have this role. Change their role on the Team page first.

errors.invalid_input: That name is already used, or a permission isn't allowed.
errors.role_in_use: People still have this role. Change their role on the Team page first.
errors.unknown: Couldn’t save the role. Try again.
